+"""Shared base for heterogeneous-bimanual task classes.
+
+Each het-bi task variant has its own Python file under
+``imbench/tasks/hetbi/`` and its own YAML config file under
+``configs/tasks/hetbi/<task_id>.yaml``.
+
+Subclasses must implement ``_compute_task_score``.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+
+import imbench.grippers  # noqa: F401  — register suction gripper
+import imbench.envs  # noqa: F401  — register HetBiEnv with robosuite
+from imbench.grippers.suction_weld import SuctionWeld
+from imbench.objects import YCBObject, ExtrasObject
+from imbench.tasks.base_task import BaseTask, load_task_config
+
+
+class HetBiBaseTask(BaseTask):
+    """Shared base for heterogeneous bimanual tasks.
+
+    Handles env construction, observations, domain randomization,
+    suction weld, and reset/step cycles.  Subclasses implement
+    ``_compute_task_score`` for task-specific success criteria.
+
+    Subclasses may override :attr:`ROBOSUITE_ENV_NAME` to swap in a
+    specialised env (e.g. one that adds a goal marker), and
+    :meth:`_extra_env_kwargs` to pass additional constructor arguments
+    to that env.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    task_id : str, optional
+        YAML config name.  Defaults to the subclass's class-level ``TASK_ID``.
+    **kwargs
+        Forwarded to ``BaseTask`` (including ``obs_mode``, ``render_mode``, etc.).
+    """
+
+    ROBOSUITE_ENV_NAME = "HetBiEnv"
+
+    def _extra_env_kwargs(self) -> dict:
+        """Hook for subclasses to inject extra env constructor kwargs."""
+        return {}
+
+    def __init__(self, task_id: str | None = None, **kwargs):
+        if task_id:
+            self.TASK_ID = task_id
+        self.CONFIG_FILE = f"hetbi/{self.TASK_ID}"
+        self._suction_weld = SuctionWeld()
+        self._payload_prefix = None
+        self._rng = np.random.RandomState(0)
+        self._payload_fell_off = False
+
+        # Pre-load the per-task config to extract variant-specific fields
+        # *before* super().__init__ (which triggers _build_env).
+        _cfg = load_task_config(self.TASK_ID, config_file=self.CONFIG_FILE,
+                               overrides=kwargs.get("config_overrides"))
+
+        self.DESCRIPTION = _cfg.get("description", getattr(self, "DESCRIPTION", ""))
+        self.YCB_PAYLOAD = _cfg.get("payload")
+        self.FIXTURE = _cfg.get("fixture")
+        self.ROBOTS = _cfg.get("robots", ["Panda", "Panda"])
+        self.GRIPPER_TYPES = _cfg.get("grippers")
+        self._variant_payload_pos = _cfg.get("payload_pos")
+        self._variant_payload_quat = _cfg.get("payload_quat")
+        self._variant_fixture_pos = _cfg.get("fixture_pos")
+        self._variant_fixture_quat = _cfg.get("fixture_quat")
+        if "max_episode_steps" in _cfg:
+            self.MAX_EPISODE_STEPS = _cfg["max_episode_steps"]
+
+        # Scene & randomization config
+        scene_cfg = _cfg.get("scene", {})
+        rand_cfg = _cfg.get("randomization", {})
+
+        # Table / arm layout
+        table_cfg = scene_cfg.get("table", {})
+        self._table_height = table_cfg.get("height", 0.9)
+        self._table_full_size = tuple(table_cfg.get("full_size", [1.0, 0.75, 0.05]))
+        _offset = table_cfg.get("offset")
+        self._table_offset = tuple(_offset) if _offset else (0, 0, self._table_height)
+        self._robot_offset = scene_cfg.get("robot_offset")  # list of [x,y,z,...] per robot or None
+        self._robot_rotation_z = scene_cfg.get("robot_rotation_z", 0.0)  # degrees; scalar or per-robot list
+
+        # Scene base visuals
+        self._object_color = scene_cfg.get("object_color")  # None = use mesh texture
+        self._table_color = scene_cfg.get("table_color", [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0])
+
+        # Physics randomization
+        mass_cfg = rand_cfg.get("payload_mass", {})
+        self._rand_payload_mass = mass_cfg.get("enabled", False)
+        self._payload_mass_range = tuple(mass_cfg["range"]) if mass_cfg.get("range") else None
+
+        pfric_cfg = rand_cfg.get("payload_friction", {})
+        self._rand_payload_friction = pfric_cfg.get("enabled", False)
+        self._payload_friction_range = tuple(pfric_cfg["range"]) if pfric_cfg.get("range") else None
+
+        tfric_cfg = rand_cfg.get("table_friction", {})
+        self._rand_table_friction = tfric_cfg.get("enabled", False)
+        self._table_friction_range = tuple(tfric_cfg["range"]) if tfric_cfg.get("range") else None
+
+        # Placement randomization
+        place_cfg = rand_cfg.get("payload_placement", {})
+        self._rand_placement = place_cfg.get("enabled", False)
+        self._place_x_std = place_cfg.get("x_std", 0.02)
+        self._place_y_std = place_cfg.get("y_std", 0.02)
+
+        # Visual randomization
+        self._rand_object_color = rand_cfg.get("object_color", {}).get("enabled", False)
+        self._rand_table_color = rand_cfg.get("table_color", {}).get("enabled", False)
+        light_cfg = rand_cfg.get("lighting", {})
+        self._rand_light_position = light_cfg.get("position", False)
+        self._rand_light_color = light_cfg.get("color", False)
+
+        # Dynamics randomization
+        act_noise_cfg = rand_cfg.get("action_noise", {})
+        self._rand_action_noise = act_noise_cfg.get("enabled", False)
+        self._action_noise_std = act_noise_cfg.get("std", 0.01)
+
+        obs_noise_cfg = rand_cfg.get("observation_noise", {})
+        self._rand_obs_noise = obs_noise_cfg.get("enabled", False)
+        self._obs_noise_std = obs_noise_cfg.get("std", 0.005)
+
+        # Task conditions (failure — common to all hetbi tasks)
+        conditions_cfg = _cfg.get("task_conditions", {})
+        failure_cfg = conditions_cfg.get("failure", {})
+        self._failure_floor_threshold = failure_cfg.get("floor_drop_below", 0.05)
+
+        # IK input scaling (used only by tasks running an IK_POSE controller).
+        # Per-arm step delta = action * sensitivity.  Defaults match the
+        # working hobi-plate-shelf setup.
+        ik_scale_cfg = _cfg.get("ik_scale", {})
+        self._ik_pos_sensitivity = ik_scale_cfg.get("pos_sensitivity", 0.005)
+        self._ik_ori_sensitivity = ik_scale_cfg.get("ori_sensitivity", 0.01)
+        # Detect IK_POSE controller from the YAML so step() can pre-scale.
+        controller_list = _cfg.get("controller", [])
+        self._uses_ik_pose = bool(
+            controller_list and any(
+                isinstance(c, dict) and str(c.get("type", "")).upper() == "IK_POSE"
+                for c in controller_list
+            )
+        )
+
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+    # ── env construction ────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+    def _build_env(self, **kwargs):
+        use_cameras = self.obs_mode in ("rgb", "combo") and self.has_cameras
+
+        common_kwargs = dict(
+            robots=self.ROBOTS,
+            control_freq=self.control_freq,
+            controller_configs=self.controller_configs,
+            has_renderer=(self.render_mode == "human"),
+            has_offscreen_renderer=use_cameras,
+            render_camera=self.viewer_camera,
+            renderer_config={"cam_config": self._viewer_cam_config} if self.render_mode == "human" else None,
+            use_camera_obs=use_cameras,
+            camera_names=self._camera_names() if use_cameras else None,
+            camera_heights=self._camera_heights() if use_cameras else 84,
+            camera_widths=self._camera_widths() if use_cameras else 84,
+            horizon=self.MAX_EPISODE_STEPS,
+            table_full_size=self._table_full_size,
+            table_offset=self._table_offset,
+        )
+
+        if self.GRIPPER_TYPES is not None:
+            common_kwargs["gripper_types"] = self.GRIPPER_TYPES
+
+        payload = YCBObject(
+            name=self.YCB_PAYLOAD, ycb_name=self.YCB_PAYLOAD,
+        )
+        fixture = None
+        if self.FIXTURE is not None:
+            fixture = ExtrasObject(
+                name=f"{self.FIXTURE}_target",
+                extras_name=self.FIXTURE, joints=None,
+            )
+        self._payload_prefix = payload.naming_prefix
+        env_kwargs = dict(
+            payload_object=payload,
+            fixture_object=fixture,
+            **common_kwargs,
+        )
+        if self._robot_offset is not None:
+            env_kwargs["robot_offset"] = self._robot_offset
+        if self._robot_rotation_z:
+            env_kwargs["robot_rotation_z"] = self._robot_rotation_z
+        if self._variant_payload_pos is not None:
+            env_kwargs["payload_pos"] = self._variant_payload_pos
+        if self._variant_payload_quat is not None:
+            env_kwargs["payload_quat"] = self._variant_payload_quat
+        if self._variant_fixture_pos is not None:
+            env_kwargs["fixture_pos"] = self._variant_fixture_pos
+        if self._variant_fixture_quat is not None:
+            env_kwargs["fixture_quat"] = self._variant_fixture_quat
+        env_kwargs.update(self._extra_env_kwargs())
+        env = self._make_robosuite_env(self.ROBOSUITE_ENV_NAME, **env_kwargs)
+        return env
+
+    # ── obs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+    def _get_obs(self, raw_obs):
+        obs = self._build_obs_from_config(raw_obs)
+
+        # Payload / object state — only include when enabled in YAML config
+        if self.object_state_enabled:
+            pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+            pos_key = f"{pf}pos"
+            quat_key = f"{pf}quat"
+            if pos_key in raw_obs:
+                obs["object_pos"] = raw_obs[pos_key]
+            if quat_key in raw_obs:
+                obs["object_quat"] = raw_obs[quat_key]
+
+        return obs
+
+    # ── termination (shared by all hetbi tasks) ────────────────────
+
+    def _check_termination(self, raw_obs):
+        pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+        pos_key = f"{pf}pos"
+
+        if pos_key not in raw_obs:
+            return False
+
+        payload_z = raw_obs[pos_key][2]
+
+        # Failure: object fell off table
+        if self._payload_fell_off:
+            return True
+        if payload_z < self._table_height - self._failure_floor_threshold:
+            self._payload_fell_off = True
+            return True
+
+        # Success: task score reached 1.0
+        if self._compute_task_score(raw_obs) >= 1.0:
+            return True
+
+        return False
+
+    def _payload_is_stable(self, vel_thresh=0.02, ang_vel_thresh=0.2):
+        """Return True if the payload's linear and angular velocities are near zero."""
+        sim = self._env.sim
+        payload = self._env._payload
+        joint_name = payload.joints[0]
+        vel_addr = sim.model.get_joint_qvel_addr(joint_name)
+        if isinstance(vel_addr, tuple):
+            vel_addr = vel_addr[0]
+        qvel = sim.data.qvel[vel_addr:vel_addr + 6]
+        lin_vel = np.linalg.norm(qvel[:3])
+        ang_vel = np.linalg.norm(qvel[3:6])
+        return lin_vel < vel_thresh and ang_vel < ang_vel_thresh
+
+    def _payload_is_stable_multistep(self, n_steps=5, vel_thresh=0.02,
+                                     ang_vel_thresh=0.2):
+        """Check stability over *n_steps* consecutive calls.
+
+        Tracks whether ``_payload_is_stable`` has been True for *n_steps*
+        consecutive evaluations (across env steps).  Returns True only once
+        the streak reaches *n_steps*.  The counter resets whenever the
+        payload is not stable.
+        """
+        if not hasattr(self, "_stable_streak"):
+            self._stable_streak = 0
+
+        if self._payload_is_stable(vel_thresh, ang_vel_thresh):
+            self._stable_streak += 1
+        else:
+            self._stable_streak = 0
+
+        return self._stable_streak >= n_steps
+
+    def _gripper_contacts_payload(self):
+        """Return True if any gripper geom is in contact with a payload geom."""
+        sim = self._env.sim
+        payload_body_id = getattr(self._env, "_payload_body_id", None)
+        if payload_body_id is None:
+            return False
+        payload_geom_ids = set()
+        for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+            if sim.model.geom_bodyid[i] == payload_body_id:
+                payload_geom_ids.add(i)
+        for i in range(sim.data.ncon):
+            contact = sim.data.contact[i]
+            g1_name = sim.model.geom_id2name(contact.geom1)
+            g2_name = sim.model.geom_id2name(contact.geom2)
+            g1_grip = g1_name and ("gripper" in g1_name or "finger" in g1_name)
+            g2_grip = g2_name and ("gripper" in g2_name or "finger" in g2_name)
+            if g1_grip and contact.geom2 in payload_geom_ids:
+                return True
+            if g2_grip and contact.geom1 in payload_geom_ids:
+                return True
+        return False
+
+    # ── step / reset with suction weld ──────────────────────────────
+
+    def reset(self, seed=None, options=None):
+        self._suction_weld.reset()
+        self._payload_fell_off = False
+        self._stable_streak = 0
+        super().reset(seed=seed, options=options)
+
+        if seed is not None:
+            self._rng = np.random.RandomState(self.seed)
+        sim = self._env.sim
+
+        # The suction snout should ONLY ever weld to the payload —
+        # never to scene geometry (table/fixture), markers, or the robot
+        # mount/links. A grazing contact during transit would otherwise
+        # lock the EEF to whatever it brushed against.
+        payload_id = getattr(self._env, "_payload_body_id", None)
+        excluded: set[int] = set()
+        if payload_id is not None:
+            for bid in range(sim.model.nbody):
+                if bid != int(payload_id):
+                    excluded.add(int(bid))
+        self._suction_weld.excluded_body_ids = excluded
+
+        # ── Physics randomization ───────────────────────────────────
+        self._randomize_physics(sim)
+
+        # ── Placement randomization (Gaussian jitter on payload pos) ─
+        if self._rand_placement:
+            self._randomize_placement(sim)
+
+        # ── Visual randomization ────────────────────────────────────
+        self._randomize_visuals(sim)
+
+        sim.forward()
+
+        # Re-observe after modifications.  force_update=True is required
+        # because robosuite caches observables per timestep — without it
+        # the cameras return stale images from before visual randomization.
+        self._camera_cache.clear()
+        raw_obs = self._get_sim_observations(force_update=True)
+
+        # Patch payload position from sim state — robosuite Observable
+        # may return a stale cached value after qpos-level placement jitter.
+        if self._rand_placement:
+            pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+            payload_body_id = getattr(self._env, "_payload_body_id", None)
+            if payload_body_id is not None:
+                raw_obs[f"{pf}pos"] = np.array(
+                    sim.data.body_xpos[payload_body_id]
+                )
+
+        self._inject_ft_sensor(raw_obs)
+        self._inject_tactile_obs(raw_obs)
+        obs = self._get_obs(raw_obs)
+        info = {"task_score": 0.0, "step": 0}
+        return obs, info
+
+    def step(self, action: np.ndarray):
+        # ── Action noise ────────────────────────────────────────────
+        if self._rand_action_noise:
+            action = action + self._rng.normal(0, self._action_noise_std,
+                                               size=action.shape)
+
+        # ── IK_POSE pre-scale ───────────────────────────────────────
+        # Robosuite's IK_POSE controller multiplies action by user_sensitivity
+        # internally (default 0.3 m / unit), giving large per-step deltas.
+        # Pre-scale at the task layer so policies can write actions as if
+        # action ∈ [-1,1] maps linearly to ±pos_sensitivity per step (matches
+        # the hobi setup).  Gripper dim is left untouched.
+        if self._uses_ik_pose:
+            action = np.asarray(action, dtype=np.float64).copy()
+            for base in (0, 7):
+                if base + 6 < action.size:
+                    action[base:base + 3] *= self._ik_pos_sensitivity
+                    action[base + 3:base + 6] *= self._ik_ori_sensitivity
+
+        obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = super().step(action)
+        self._suction_weld.update(self._env, action)
+
+        # ── Observation noise (proprio keys only) ───────────────────
+        if self._rand_obs_noise:
+            for key in obs:
+                if isinstance(obs[key], np.ndarray) and key.startswith("robot"):
+                    obs[key] = obs[key] + self._rng.normal(
+                        0, self._obs_noise_std, size=obs[key].shape
+                    )
+
+        return obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info
+
+    # ── physics randomization ───────────────────────────────────────
+
+    def _randomize_physics(self, sim):
+        """Apply physics domain randomization (mass, friction) to the sim."""
+        payload_body_id = getattr(self._env, "_payload_body_id", None)
+
+        # ── Payload mass ────────────────────────────────────────────
+        if self._rand_payload_mass and self._payload_mass_range and payload_body_id is not None:
+            sim.model.body_mass[payload_body_id] = self._rng.uniform(
+                *self._payload_mass_range
+            )
+
+        # ── Payload friction ────────────────────────────────────────
+        if self._rand_payload_friction and self._payload_friction_range and payload_body_id is not None:
+            fric = self._rng.uniform(*self._payload_friction_range)
+            for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+                if sim.model.geom_bodyid[i] == payload_body_id:
+                    sim.model.geom_friction[i][0] = fric
+
+        # ── Table friction ──────────────────────────────────────────
+        if self._rand_table_friction and self._table_friction_range:
+            fric = self._rng.uniform(*self._table_friction_range)
+            for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+                name = sim.model.geom_id2name(i)
+                if name and "table" in name and "visual" not in name:
+                    sim.model.geom_friction[i][0] = fric
+
+    # ── placement randomization ─────────────────────────────────────
+
+    def _randomize_placement(self, sim):
+        """Apply Gaussian jitter to the payload position (x, y only)."""
+        payload = self._env._payload
+        joint_name = payload.joints[0]
+        addr = sim.model.get_joint_qpos_addr(joint_name)
+        if isinstance(addr, tuple):
+            addr = addr[0]
+
+        # Read current pos, add Gaussian jitter on x and y, keep z.
+        qpos = sim.data.qpos[addr:addr + 7].copy()
+        qpos[0] += self._rng.normal(0, self._place_x_std)
+        qpos[1] += self._rng.normal(0, self._place_y_std)
+        sim.data.qpos[addr:addr + 7] = qpos
+
+        # Zero out velocity so jittered position is stable.
+        vel_addr = sim.model.get_joint_qvel_addr(joint_name)
+        if isinstance(vel_addr, tuple):
+            vel_addr = vel_addr[0]
+        sim.data.qvel[vel_addr:vel_addr + 6] = 0.0
+
+    # ── visual randomization ────────────────────────────────────────
+
+    def _randomize_visuals(self, sim):
+        """Apply visual domain randomization (colors + lighting) to the sim."""
+        payload_body_id = getattr(self._env, "_payload_body_id", None)
+
+        # ── Object color ────────────────────────────────────────────
+        if self._rand_object_color and payload_body_id is not None:
+            obj_rgba = self._random_object_color()
+            for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+                if sim.model.geom_bodyid[i] == payload_body_id:
+                    sim.model.geom_matid[i] = -1  # strip texture
+                    sim.model.geom_rgba[i] = obj_rgba
+        elif self._object_color is not None and payload_body_id is not None:
+            obj_rgba = np.array(self._object_color)
+            for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+                if sim.model.geom_bodyid[i] == payload_body_id:
+                    sim.model.geom_matid[i] = -1
+                    sim.model.geom_rgba[i] = obj_rgba
+
+        # ── Table color ─────────────────────────────────────────────
+        table_rgba = (
+            self._random_table_color() if self._rand_table_color
+            else np.array(self._table_color)
+        )
+        for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+            name = sim.model.geom_id2name(i)
+            if name and name == "table_visual":
+                sim.model.geom_rgba[i] = table_rgba
+                mat_id = sim.model.geom_matid[i]
+                if mat_id >= 0:
+                    sim.model.mat_rgba[mat_id] = table_rgba
+
+        # ── Lighting randomization ──────────────────────────────────
+        for i in range(sim.model.nlight):
+            if self._rand_light_position:
+                sim.model.light_pos[i] = [
+                    self._rng.uniform(0.0, 2.0),
+                    self._rng.uniform(-1.0, 2.0),
+                    self._rng.uniform(1.0, 2.5),
+                ]
+            if self._rand_light_color:
+                # Near-white warm-to-cool lighting; avoid strongly colored
+                # lights (e.g. red, green, blue).
+                base = self._rng.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
+                jitter = self._rng.uniform(-0.08, 0.08, size=3)
+                diffuse = np.clip(base + jitter, 0.4, 1.0)
+                sim.model.light_diffuse[i] = diffuse
+                amb_base = self._rng.uniform(0.05, 0.25)
+                amb_jitter = self._rng.uniform(-0.04, 0.04, size=3)
+                sim.model.light_ambient[i] = np.clip(
+                    amb_base + amb_jitter, 0.0, 0.4
+                )
+
+    # ── color helpers (realistic palette) ───────────────────────────
+
+    def _random_object_color(self):
+        """Sample a plausible object color — muted, avoids neon extremes."""
+        rgb = self._rng.uniform(0.15, 0.85, size=3)
+        gray = rgb.mean()
+        rgb = 0.5 * rgb + 0.5 * gray
+        rgb = np.clip(rgb, 0.1, 0.9)
+        return np.array([*rgb, 1.0])
+
+    def _random_table_color(self):
+        """Sample a realistic table-top color (neutrals: grays, off-whites, light wood)."""
+        base = self._rng.uniform(0.45, 0.95)
+        jitter = self._rng.uniform(-0.06, 0.06, size=3)
+        jitter[0] += self._rng.uniform(0.0, 0.04)
+        rgb = np.clip(base + jitter, 0.3, 1.0)
+        return np.array([*rgb, 1.0])

+"""Bowl Table Transfer — heterogeneous bimanual task.
+
+Task ID: ``ib-p1-bowl-table-v1``
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+import robosuite.utils.transform_utils as T
+
+from imbench.tasks.hetbi.base_hetbi import HetBiBaseTask
+
+
+class BowlTableV1(HetBiBaseTask):
+    """Bowl from rack to table using finger + suction grippers.
+
+    Finger gripper (robot 0) grasps the bowl rim inside a rack compartment
+    and extracts it, then hands it over to suction gripper (robot 1) which
+    attaches to the flat bottom and places it on the table.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    task_id : str, optional
+        Defaults to ``"ib-p1-bowl-table-v1"``.
+    **kwargs
+        Forwarded to ``HetBiBaseTask``.
+    """
+
+    TASK_ID = "ib-p1-bowl-table-v1"
+    DESCRIPTION = (
+        "Bowl starts upside-down inside a rack compartment. Finger gripper "
+        "(robot 0) grasps the bowl rim and extracts it from the rack, then "
+        "hands it over to suction gripper (robot 1) which attaches to the "
+        "flat bottom and places it on the table."
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, task_id: str = None, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(task_id=task_id or self.TASK_ID, **kwargs)
+        success_cfg = self.cfg.get("task_conditions", {}).get("success", {})
+        self._success_dist_threshold = success_cfg.get("dist_threshold", 0.05)
+
+    def _compute_task_score(self, raw_obs):
+        pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+        pos_key = f"{pf}pos"
+        quat_key = f"{pf}quat"
+
+        if pos_key not in raw_obs:
+            return 0.0
+
+        payload_pos = np.array(raw_obs[pos_key])
+        payload_z = payload_pos[2]
+
+        if payload_z < self._table_height - self._failure_floor_threshold:
+            self._payload_fell_off = True
+            return 0.0
+
+        on_table = self._table_height <= payload_z <= self._table_height + 0.05
+
+        # Check bowl is upright: local z-axis points up in world frame.
+        # T.quat2mat expects xyzw — observation is already xyzw.
+        # Only check mat[2,2] (world-z component of local z-axis).
+        # Any yaw rotation around world-z is acceptable, so we don't
+        # constrain x or y axes.
+        upright = False
+        z_axis_z = float('nan')
+        if quat_key in raw_obs:
+            mat = T.quat2mat(np.array(raw_obs[quat_key]))
+            z_axis_z = mat[2, 2]
+            upright = z_axis_z > 0.9
+
+        score = 1.0 if (on_table and upright) else 0.0
+        return score

+"""Cracker Box Bimanual Transfer to Slot — heterogeneous bimanual task.
+
+Task ID: ``ib-p1-cracker-box-slot-v1``
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+import robosuite.utils.transform_utils as T
+
+from imbench.tasks.hetbi.base_hetbi import HetBiBaseTask
+
+
+class CrackerBoxSlotV1(HetBiBaseTask):
+    """Cracker box from table into slot fixture using finger + suction grippers.
+
+    Finger gripper (robot 0) grasps the box and lifts it, then hands it over
+    to suction gripper (robot 1) which attaches to a flat face and slides
+    the box into the slot.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    task_id : str, optional
+        Defaults to ``"ib-p1-cracker-box-slot-v1"``.
+    **kwargs
+        Forwarded to ``HetBiBaseTask``.
+    """
+
+    TASK_ID = "ib-p1-cracker-box-slot-v1"
+    DESCRIPTION = (
+        "Cracker box starts flat on the table beside a horizontal slot "
+        "fixture whose opening closely matches the box cross-section. "
+        "Finger gripper (robot 0) grasps the box and lifts it, then hands "
+        "it over to suction gripper (robot 1) which attaches to a flat face "
+        "and slides the box into the slot."
+    )
+
+    _SLOT_RGBA = np.array([0.8, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0])  # red
+
+    def __init__(self, task_id: str = None, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(task_id=task_id or self.TASK_ID, **kwargs)
+        success_cfg = self.cfg.get("task_conditions", {}).get("success", {})
+        self._center_dist_threshold = success_cfg.get("dist_threshold", 0.05)
+
+    def reset(self, seed=None, options=None):
+        obs, info = super().reset(seed=seed, options=options)
+        self._tint_fixture(self._SLOT_RGBA)
+        return obs, info
+
+    def _tint_fixture(self, rgba):
+        """Recolor every geom belonging to the slot fixture body."""
+        fixture_body_id = getattr(self._env, "_fixture_body_id", None)
+        if fixture_body_id is None:
+            return
+        sim = self._env.sim
+        for i in range(sim.model.ngeom):
+            if sim.model.geom_bodyid[i] == fixture_body_id:
+                sim.model.geom_matid[i] = -1  # strip any material
+                sim.model.geom_rgba[i] = rgba
+        sim.forward()
+
+    def _compute_task_score(self, raw_obs):
+        pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+        pos_key = f"{pf}pos"
+
+        if pos_key not in raw_obs:
+            return 0.0
+
+        payload_pos = np.array(raw_obs[pos_key])
+        payload_z = payload_pos[2]
+
+        if payload_z < self._table_height - self._failure_floor_threshold:
+            self._payload_fell_off = True
+            return 0.0
+        if self._payload_fell_off:
+            return 0.0
+
+        # Success: box centre is within `dist_threshold` of the slot-interior
+        # centre.  This is stricter than "inside bounds" because the box is
+        # larger than the slot interior — any axis-aligned offset leaves
+        # part of the box protruding from the slot opening.
+        fixture_bounds = getattr(self._env, "_fixture_bounds", None)
+        if fixture_bounds is None:
+            return 0.0
+
+        slot_centre = np.array([
+            0.5 * (fixture_bounds["x"][0] + fixture_bounds["x"][1]),
+            0.5 * (fixture_bounds["y"][0] + fixture_bounds["y"][1]),
+            0.5 * (fixture_bounds["z"][0] + fixture_bounds["z"][1]),
+        ])
+        if np.linalg.norm(payload_pos - slot_centre) <= self._center_dist_threshold:
+            return 1.0
+
+        return 0.0

+"""Cracker Box — suction-only variant of the slot-insertion task.
+
+Task ID: ``ib-p1-cracker-box-suction-v1``
+
+Identical scene, objects, fixture, and reward as
+``ib-p1-cracker-box-slot-v1``, except the parallel-jaw arm is frozen
+— only the suction arm can move.  The robot index of each gripper is
+read from ``grippers:`` in the YAML config, so swapping the list order
+correctly re-targets the freeze.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from imbench.tasks.hetbi.cracker_box_slot_v1 import CrackerBoxSlotV1
+
+
+# Each arm contributes 7 action dims (6 pose + 1 gripper) under OSC_POSE.
+_ARM_ACTION_DIM = 7
+
+
+def _find_robot_index(grippers: list[str], keyword: str) -> int:
+    """Return index of the first gripper whose name contains *keyword*
+    (case-insensitive).  Raises ``ValueError`` if no match is found."""
+    kw = keyword.lower()
+    for i, g in enumerate(grippers):
+        if kw in str(g).lower():
+            return i
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"No gripper containing {keyword!r} found in grippers list: {grippers}"
+    )
+
+
+class CrackerBoxSuctionV1(CrackerBoxSlotV1):
+
+    TASK_ID = "ib-p1-cracker-box-suction-v1"
+    DESCRIPTION = (
+        "Cracker box starts flat on the table beside a horizontal slot. "
+        "Only the suction-gripper arm may move; the parallel-jaw arm is "
+        "present but frozen.  Suction must pick and slide the box into "
+        "the slot on its own."
+    )
+
+    # Which gripper keyword identifies the FROZEN arm.  Overridden by the
+    # jaw-only variant.
+    _FROZEN_GRIPPER_KEYWORD = "pandagripper"
+
+    def __init__(self, task_id: str = None, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(task_id=task_id or self.TASK_ID, **kwargs)
+        grippers = self.cfg.get("grippers", [])
+        frozen_robot = _find_robot_index(grippers, self._FROZEN_GRIPPER_KEYWORD)
+        start = frozen_robot * _ARM_ACTION_DIM
+        self._frozen_action_slice = slice(start, start + _ARM_ACTION_DIM)
+
+    def step(self, action: np.ndarray):
+        action = np.asarray(action, dtype=np.float64).copy()
+        action[self._frozen_action_slice] = 0.0
+        return super().step(action)

+"""Cup Inversion — heterogeneous bimanual task.
+
+Task ID: ``ib-p1-cup-inversion-v1``
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+import robosuite.utils.transform_utils as T
+
+from imbench.tasks.base_task import load_task_config
+from imbench.tasks.hetbi.base_hetbi import HetBiBaseTask
+
+
+class CupInversionV1(HetBiBaseTask):
+    """Cup inversion using finger + suction grippers.
+
+    Cup starts inverted (upside-down) on the table with its flat base
+    exposed upward.  Suction gripper (robot 1) attaches to the flat base
+    and lifts the cup, then hands it over to finger gripper (robot 0)
+    which receives it upright and places it inside a green goal region
+    on the table.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    task_id : str, optional
+        Defaults to ``"ib-p1-cup-inversion-v1"``.
+    **kwargs
+        Forwarded to ``HetBiBaseTask``.
+    """
+
+    TASK_ID = "ib-p1-cup-inversion-v1"
+    ROBOSUITE_ENV_NAME = "HetBiCupInversionEnv"
+    DESCRIPTION = (
+        "A handle-less cup (YCB stacking cup) starts inverted (upside-down) "
+        "on the table with its flat base exposed upward. Suction gripper "
+        "(robot 1) attaches to the flat base and lifts the cup, then hands "
+        "it over to finger gripper (robot 0) which receives it upright and "
+        "places it inside a green goal region on the table."
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, task_id: str = None, **kwargs):
+        # Pre-load config so _extra_env_kwargs() has the goal area
+        # available when super().__init__ triggers _build_env.
+        tid = task_id or self.TASK_ID
+        _cfg = load_task_config(tid, config_file=f"hetbi/{tid}",
+                                overrides=kwargs.get("config_overrides"))
+        goal_cfg = _cfg.get("goal_area", {}) or {}
+        self._goal_pos = (
+            np.array(goal_cfg["pos"], dtype=np.float64)
+            if goal_cfg.get("pos") is not None else None
+        )
+        size = goal_cfg.get("size", [0.1, 0.1])
+        self._goal_half_size = (float(size[0]) / 2.0, float(size[1]) / 2.0)
+        self._goal_rgba = tuple(goal_cfg.get("rgba", [0.0, 0.8, 0.0, 0.5]))
+
+        super().__init__(task_id=tid, **kwargs)
+
+        success_cfg = self.cfg.get("task_conditions", {}).get("success", {})
+        self._success_lift_height = success_cfg.get("lift_height", 0.10)
+
+    def _extra_env_kwargs(self) -> dict:
+        if self._goal_pos is None:
+            return {}
+        return {
+            "goal_pos": self._goal_pos.tolist(),
+            "goal_half_size": self._goal_half_size,
+            "goal_rgba": self._goal_rgba,
+        }
+
+    def _compute_task_score(self, raw_obs):
+        pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+        pos_key = f"{pf}pos"
+
+        if pos_key not in raw_obs:
+            return 0.0
+
+        payload_pos = np.array(raw_obs[pos_key])
+        payload_z = payload_pos[2]
+
+        if payload_z < self._table_height - self._failure_floor_threshold:
+            self._payload_fell_off = True
+            return 0.0
+        if self._payload_fell_off:
+            return 0.0
+
+        # Success: cup resting upright on the table, stable, and — if a
+        # goal region is configured — inside that region.
+        quat_key = f"{pf}quat"
+        on_table = self._table_height <= payload_z <= self._table_height + 0.05
+        if on_table and quat_key in raw_obs:
+            quat_xyzw = np.array(raw_obs[quat_key])
+            mat = T.quat2mat(quat_xyzw)
+            if mat[2, 2] > 0.9 and self._payload_in_goal_region(payload_pos):
+                return 1.0
+
+        return 0.0
+
+    def _payload_in_goal_region(self, payload_pos: np.ndarray) -> bool:
+        """Return True if no goal is configured, or payload xy is in region."""
+        if self._goal_pos is None:
+            return True
+        hx, hy = self._goal_half_size
+        dx = abs(payload_pos[0] - self._goal_pos[0])
+        dy = abs(payload_pos[1] - self._goal_pos[1])
+        return dx <= hx and dy <= hy

+"""Plate Table-to-Shelf Transfer — heterogeneous bimanual task.
+
+Task ID: ``ib-p1-plate-shelf-hetbi-v1``
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from imbench.tasks.hetbi.base_hetbi import HetBiBaseTask
+
+
+class PlateShelfV1(HetBiBaseTask):
+    """Plate from table into shelf slot using suction + finger grippers.
+
+    Suction gripper (robot 0) attaches to the flat plate surface and
+    lifts it, then hands it over to finger gripper (robot 1) which
+    grasps the plate edge and inserts it on-edge into the center shelf
+    slot.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    task_id : str, optional
+        Defaults to ``"ib-p1-plate-shelf-hetbi-v1"``.
+    **kwargs
+        Forwarded to ``HetBiBaseTask``.
+    """
+
+    TASK_ID = "ib-p1-plate-shelf-hetbi-v1"
+    DESCRIPTION = (
+        "Plate lies flat on the table beside a shelf. Suction gripper "
+        "(robot 0) attaches to the flat plate surface and lifts it, then "
+        "hands it over to finger gripper (robot 1) which grasps the plate "
+        "edge and inserts it on-edge into the center shelf slot."
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, task_id: str = None, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(task_id=task_id or self.TASK_ID, **kwargs)
+
+    def _compute_task_score(self, raw_obs):
+        pf = self._payload_prefix or "payload_"
+        pos_key = f"{pf}pos"
+
+        if pos_key not in raw_obs:
+            return 0.0
+
+        payload_pos = np.array(raw_obs[pos_key])
+        payload_z = payload_pos[2]
+
+        if payload_z < self._table_height - self._failure_floor_threshold:
+            self._payload_fell_off = True
+            return 0.0
+        if self._payload_fell_off:
+            return 0.0
+
+        # Success: plate inside shelf bounds
+        fixture_bounds = getattr(self._env, "_fixture_bounds", None)
+        if fixture_bounds is not None:
+            x_ok = fixture_bounds["x"][0] <= payload_pos[0] <= fixture_bounds["x"][1]
+            y_ok = fixture_bounds["y"][0] <= payload_pos[1] <= fixture_bounds["y"][1]
+            z_ok = fixture_bounds["z"][0] <= payload_pos[2] <= fixture_bounds["z"][1]
+            if x_ok and y_ok and z_ok:
+                return 1.0
+
+        return 0.0

+"""Dining Table Assembly — homogeneous bimanual task.
+
+A dining table is scattered with common YCB objects (mugs, bowls, fruit,
+bottles, …).  Coloured circular goal markers are placed at random positions
+on the table surface.  Each arm must pick up its assigned objects and place
+them on the matching coloured goal zone.
+
+Assignment is config-driven: ``arm0_objects`` lists the YCB names that the
+**scripted** arm (arm 0) must place; ``arm1_objects`` lists those assigned to
+the **teleoperated** arm (arm 1).  The colour of each goal zone is fixed per
+object (red/blue/green for arm 0; yellow/cyan/magenta for arm 1) so the
+operator always knows which marker belongs to which object.
+
+Object scatter positions **and** goal zone positions are both randomised on
+every episode reset.  The two sets of positions are kept sufficiently
+separated so neither arm starts with an object already on its goal zone.
+
+Scoring:
+- Each object whose centroid sits within ``xy_tolerance`` of its goal zone
+  centre AND is resting near table height (``z_tolerance``) is counted as
+  correctly placed.
+- Final score = placed_correctly / total_objects.
+
+Task ID: ``ib-m-dining-table-v1``
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+
+import numpy as np
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+from robosuite.utils import transform_utils as T
+
+import imbench.envs  # noqa: F401 — register envs
+from imbench.objects import ExtrasObject, YCBObject
+from imbench.tasks.base_task import BaseTask, load_task_config
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#  Constants
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#  Per-object grasp affordances (derived from YCB mesh geometry)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Gripper geometry (PandaGripper + grip_site):
+#   • grip_site is the grasping point — its world position = robot0_eef_pos.
+#   • grip_site z_col ≈ [0, 0.13, -0.99]: approach direction is straight DOWN.
+#   • grip_site x_col = [-1, 0, 0]: fingers open / close along world ±X.
+#   • Gripper max opening span: ≈ 80 mm (PandaGripper hardware spec).
+#   • Workspace stall at full arm reach: EEF z ≈ table_z + 0.089 m.
+#
+# For reliable scripted grasping every object in arm0 must satisfy:
+#   (a) narrow_dim_X ≤ 80 mm  — fits between finger pads
+#   (b) centroid_z ≈ table_z + 0.079–0.110 m  — reachable by OSC arm
+#       (centroid = half object height above table)
+#
+# Objects are spawned with identity quaternion (upright, mesh default axes).
+# In YCB convention the NARROWEST horizontal mesh extent is along world-X,
+# so the gripper's X-opening direction aligns with the narrow face.
+#
+# Affordance fields:
+#   grasp_clearance   target EEF z above table = centroid height.
+#                     Arm descends to this z; z-band trigger fires there.
+#   hover_height      EEF transit height above table.  Must exceed
+#                     obj_half_height + tallest_OTHER_obj_height + 0.04 m
+#                     so the carried object clears everything on the table.
+#   place_height      EEF z at release.  Object is lowered to rest height.
+#   grasp_x_width_mm  Gripper span needed (narrow mesh X dimension).
+#                     Shown for documentation; must be < 80 mm.
+_GRASP_AFFORDANCES: dict[str, dict] = {
+    # ── sugar_box ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    # Mesh BBox (YCB): x=47 mm × y=94 mm × z=177 mm  (standing upright)
+    # Narrow face X = 47 mm  → gripper opens in X ✓
+    # Centroid above table: 177/2 = 88.5 mm  → grasp_z = 0.9 + 0.089 ≈ 0.989
+    "sugar_box": {
+        "grasp_clearance":  0.089,   # ≈ centroid (88.5 mm)
+        "approach_height":  0.24,    # EEF z during initial hover → obj (lower = faster reach)
+        "transit_height":   0.40,    # EEF z when carrying over scene (clears 177+192+40 mm)
+        "place_height":     0.20,    # EEF z at release
+        "grasp_x_width_mm": 47,
+    },
+    # ── mustard_bottle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    # Mesh BBox (YCB): x=58 mm × y=96 mm × z=192 mm  (standing upright)
+    # Narrow face X = 58 mm  → gripper opens in X ✓
+    # Centroid: 192/2 = 96 mm → grasp_z = 0.996; arm stalls at ≈0.989, z-band fires
+    "mustard_bottle": {
+        "grasp_clearance":  0.096,
+        "approach_height":  0.26,
+        "transit_height":   0.44,    # clears mustard top (192) + cracker (216) + margin
+        "place_height":     0.20,
+        "grasp_x_width_mm": 58,
+    },
+    # ── cracker_box ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    # Mesh BBox (YCB): x=75 mm × y=166 mm × z=216 mm  (standing upright)
+    # Narrow face X = 75 mm  → just fits in gripper (< 80 mm) ✓
+    # Centroid: 216/2 = 108 mm → ideal grasp_z = 1.008; arm stalls at ~0.989
+    "cracker_box": {
+        "grasp_clearance":  0.108,
+        "approach_height":  0.28,
+        "transit_height":   0.40,
+        "place_height":     0.20,
+        "grasp_x_width_mm": 75,
+    },
+    # ── tomato_soup_can ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    # Mesh BBox (YCB): x=68 mm × y=68 mm × z=103 mm  (cylindrical, upright)
+    # Symmetric → no preferred X alignment needed.
+    # Centroid: 103/2 = 51.5 mm  → grasp_z = 0.952; arm stalls at 0.989

+    "tomato_soup_can": {

+        "approach_height":  0.20,
+        "transit_height":   0.36,
+        "place_height":     0.20,
+        "grasp_x_width_mm": 68,
+    },
+    # ── apple ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    # Mesh BBox (YCB): x=75 mm × y=75 mm × z=72 mm  (near-sphere)
+    # arm1 (teleop) only — centroid too low for scripted arm at full reach.
+    "apple": {
+        "grasp_clearance":  0.036,
+        "approach_height":  0.18,

+    },

+        "grasp_clearance":  0.034,
+        "approach_height":  0.18,
+        "transit_height":   0.18,
+        "place_height":     0.15,
+        "grasp_x_width_mm": 71,
+    },
+}
+
+# Fallback affordance when an object name is not in the table above.
+_DEFAULT_AFFORDANCE: dict = {
+    "grasp_clearance":  0.090,
+    "approach_height":  0.22,
+    "transit_height":   0.36,
+    "place_height":     0.20,
+    "grasp_x_width_mm": 80,
+}
+
+# Default dining objects.
+# arm0 (scripted): all three are tall boxes with centroids reachable at the
+#   OSC workspace stall height (z ≈ table_z + 0.089 m) and narrow X ≤ 80 mm.
+# arm1 (teleop): shorter/spherical — human operator can reach any height.
+_DEFAULT_ARM0_OBJECTS = ["sugar_box", "mustard_bottle", "cracker_box"]

+# Colour marker asset name for each position in each arm's list (3 max).

+# OSC action scaling: robosuite default output_max = 0.05 m per unit action.
+_OSC_POS_SCALE = 0.05  # m per normalised action unit

+# Workspace bounds for scattering objects and placing goal zones.
+# Table is 1.2 × 0.8 m (x: ±0.60, y: ±0.40).  Keep ≥0.12 m clear of all
+# four edges to prevent wide objects (bowl, bottle, ~0.10 m radius) from
+# overhanging and falling off.
+_ARM0_SCATTER = dict(x=(-0.22, 0.22), y=(-0.27, -0.05))
+_ARM0_GOALS   = dict(x=(-0.22, 0.22), y=(-0.27, -0.05))
+_ARM1_SCATTER = dict(x=(-0.22, 0.22), y=(0.05, 0.27))
+_ARM1_GOALS   = dict(x=(-0.22, 0.22), y=(0.05, 0.27))
+
+# Minimum goal↔goal separation so markers don't overlap (diameter = 0.16 m).
+_MIN_GOAL_GOAL_SEP = 0.17  # m
+# Minimum object↔object scatter separation so objects don't collide on spawn.
+_MIN_OBJ_OBJ_SEP  = 0.13  # m
+
+# Scripted arm OSC action speed caps.
+_SPEED_TRANSIT = 0.55   # fraction of max speed for long-range motion
+_SPEED_FINE    = 0.30   # fraction for precision approach

+# Z-only descent trigger band (metres above target_z) for grasp_hold.
+# The arm stalls at different z values depending on reach configuration.
+# Using 0.070 m band ensures the trigger fires when the arm stalls 55+ mm
+# above the nominal target z (empirically observed for sugar_box at y=-0.178).

+# z-band hasn't fired (handles extreme workspace configurations).
+_MAX_DESCEND_STEPS = 200

+_STASH_Z = -2.0
